tool_definition.description:
Use to perform a natural-language search to find information and retrieve the most relevant results.
Example Scenario: A journalist needs to quickly find authoritative explanations of how the EU AI Act classifies AI systems by risk tier and what obligations apply to each category, including enforcement timelines and key dates, to prepare an explainer article.. Call with {"query": "EU AI Act classification of AI systems risk tiers (unacceptable, high-risk, limited, minimal), obligations and compliance requirements for each tier, conformity assessment, transparency, enforcement timelines and key dates, official EU sources (EUR-Lex, European Commission) and reputable analyses, latest 2024-2026 updates"}
